messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU capacity exhausted in gcp-eu-north3. Autoscaler attempted allocations but API returns quotaExceeded / RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. Queue length for inference-pool-1 growing ~4x in 10m. Customer-facing errors: 429s on /v1/generate and delayed embeddings. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-quota-hit. Paging sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: On it. Joining bridge now. Quick check: autoscaler logs + provider API errors. Any immediate customer escalations?

alice.m: Seeing spike in throttles for hosted API keys v-prod-*. Customers reporting slow responses, some timeouts. Dashboard: per-route latency up 500ms, error rate 6%. Sending heads-up to Support.

ben.platform: I can try to force-failover routing to eu-west2 pool if capacity there is free. Before that, need to confirm model compatibility and routing policy. If we reroute, we'll see short-lived increased latency for affected sessions.

cara-support: Alerted top 5 customers on the affected plan. Liaising on mitigations. One enterprise customer is asking for ETA.

darren-ops: From autoscaler events: "Failed to create instance: quotaExceeded (GPUS_PER_REGION)". Full event sample: ```Event: CreateInstanceFailed region=gcp-eu-north3 reason=quotaExceeded resource=accelerator type=nvidia-a10g```

sre-oncall: Confirmed. It looks like project-level quota for A10G GPUs hit. Attempts to allocate alternate machine types fall back and then fail due to lack of compatible images in zone.

capacity-eng: We opened quota ticket with GCP 12m ago (case 123456789). Support responded: "Quota increase pending review, ~2-4h typical". We can try transient mitigation: route lower-memory model variants to CPU-backed nodes for non-latency-sensitive requests, and throttle non-critical eval jobs.

sre-oncall: Actions: 1) Enable immediate routing policy to spill overflow to eu-west2 (ben.platform) 2) Throttle background evals and batch jobs (darren-ops) 3) Toggle per-customer priority: deprioritize free-tier / background traffic (cara-support) 4) Engage infra to attempt graceful downscales of unneeded warm pools in eu-north3 to free GPUs (capacity-eng).

ben.platform: Preparing routing change. Quick check: model compatibility matrix shows all current models have eu-west2 variants except a custom 30B customer model pinned to eu-north3. We'll need to keep that pinned -> plan: keep pinned sessions on current pool where possible, shift everything else. Applying routing rule now: `POST /admin/routing` payload will add spillover policy.

sre-oncall: Throttling background jobs now: `kubectl label job/* batch-throttle=true` and pausing non-essential work via `./tools/pauser pause --tag=evals`. CPU-mode fallback policy enabled for embeddings-only endpoints.

cara-support: Customer on enterprise plan notified that we are routing traffic and prioritizing them; they'll accept degraded latency but not errors. They asked for window estimate; I said worst-case 3-4 hours pending quota approval but will update.

darren-ops: Attempting warm-pool pruning in eu-north3: listing nodes -> `gcloud compute instances list --filter="labels=warmpool AND region=eu-north3"` -> identified 6 idle instances with attached accelerators. Kicking cleanup. If successful, should free ~24 GPUs.

sre-oncall: If warm-pool reclaim doesn't free enough, fallback is cross-region spill + model-quantized lower-memory variants for a subset of requests. Also consider emergency use of dedicated reserved capacity from customer-dedicated pools (if contracted).

capacity-eng: Noted. Also spinning up request to enable lesser GPU SKUs in eu-north3 (if allowed) as fallback; that will require image compatibility work. This is a 30m manual step.

sre-oncall: Quick status update in 10m. Please post any errors / logs here. Adding emoji reactions to track ack: :rotating_light: :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

incident-bot: NOTE: Bridge created -> https://meetings.redwood/bridges/6765432100. Pager duty incident id: PD-98765.

ben.platform: Routing rule applied for non-pinned sessions -> spillover to eu-west2. Monitoring for error spikes.

darren-ops: Warm-pool prune succeeded, freed 18 GPUs (expected 24). Queue processing rate improved ~30%. Some backlog still remains.

sre-oncall: Observed queue length dropping, error rate down to 2.1%, latency trending to baseline. Keeping throttle on background jobs for now.

cara-support: Customers updated. Enterprise customer responded: "Thanks — good tradeoffs, keep us posted."

capacity-eng: GCP case updated: support asked for more usage details, provided. They've moved it to expedite; ETA still open.

sre-oncall: Closing actions for now: 1) keep spillover routing until quota confirmed 2) maintain background throttles for 1h 3) capacity team to continue reclamation and support ticket 4) postmortem owner: ben.platform. I'll set a follow-up thread.

ben.platform: Will own PM. Filing follow-up and schedule postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
